kept.claim: Revenue rose 26% from a year earlier to about $1.47 billion in the quarter. Management attributes the subscription growth mainly to new customers and to selling more sensors and modules to existing customers.

Gross margin was 74.6% in the quarter, compared with 73.6% a year earlier, an improvement of about 1.0 percentage points. Management says the subscription gross margin improvement came mainly from hiring efficiencies.

The operating loss narrowed to $33.2 million in the quarter from a loss of $105.5 million a year earlier. General and administrative expenses stayed largely flat because lower costs tied to the Falcon sensor outage and smaller charges under the restructuring plan offset higher stock-based compensation.

dropped.claim: Operating cash flow was $530.3 million in the quarter, up 59% from a year earlier. For the first half of the year, the filing describes operating cash as net income plus large non-cash charges, led by stock-based compensation, along with a decline in accounts receivable.
